# ResumeBench-Mix
**Type:** Measurement  
**Referenced in:** 1 paper  

## State of the Field

ResumeBench-Mix, a combined real-synthetic dataset created by pairing public real resumes with an equal number of synthetic resumes in five languages for evaluation.

## Sources

**[Beyond Human Labels: A Multi-Linguistic Auto-Generated Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on Resume Parsing](https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.1626.pdf)**
> ResumeBench-Mix, a combined real-synthetic dataset created by pairing public real resumes with an equal number of synthetic resumes in five languages for evaluation.
